Department of Food Science & Technology

University of Kashmir, Hazratbal Srinagar-190 006.
No: (Advertisement/SSL/JKDST) FST/KU/2026
Date: 05.06.2026
Advertisement Notice
Applications are invited for the 01 position of Semi Skilled Labour under the Government of
Jammu & Kashmir Department of Science & Technology sanctioned project implemented by
the Department of Food Science & Technology, University of Kashmir.
Position: Semi Skilled Labour (01)
Eligibility:
 Candidates must have know-how of the apple orchard work.
 Understandig of basic agricultural tasks.
 Having relevant experience in agricultural/field work.
 Having Multi-Tasking skills
Nature of Work:
 Multi-Tasking
 Assistance in project-related laboratory and field activities.
 Support in handling materials, sample preparation, and orchard-related work.
Duration: Purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The engagement shall not confer
any right for regular appointment.
Salary: 8000/month
How to Apply:
Interested candidates may submit their application along with relevant documents to the office of
the Department of Food Science & Technology, University of Kashmir, Srinagar – 190006, on
or before 15th June 2026. For any related queries contact, +91-9622709721/ +91-7006599755
Important Note:
The incumbent presently working against this position has submitted an advance notice of
resignation and has agreed to continue in service until a suitable replacement is selected and joins
the position. Accordingly, the selected candidate shall be offered the appointment immediately
upon the relieving of the present incumbent or as decided by the competent authority.
Dr. Adil Gani
Principal Investigator
